surface_fidelity: production web entrypoint; auth replaced by isolated test account, object lifecycle untouched
persona: First-time user who wants to save one note and come back to it tomorrow
goal: Create one note, leave, and find the same note again

steps.observation: Home shows 'Notes (0)' and a New button

steps.action: tap New, then Back, again without typing

findings.title: Empty editor exits create persistent untitled notes
findings.claim: Opening the editor and leaving without typing adds one object each time
findings.visible_evidence: Notes count went 0 -> 1 -> 2 across two empty cycles (steps 2-3)
findings.impact: Users accumulate blank notes they never asked for
findings.inference: Product may intend automatic drafts; controller must check the declared draft/commit semantics before accepting

unknowns: Whether native process relaunch keeps the same three objects
